case.title: Shadows over the Sunlit Terrace
case.introduction: A glamorous art exhibition is held at the secluded Villa Aurelia, owned by the enigmatic philanthropist Damien Blackwood. Among the guests is a renowned art curator, a stoic security chief, and a talented chef. As the night unfolds, the centerpiece painting disappears, and a web of secrets threatens to unravel the truth.
case.crime: The priceless masterpiece "Midnight Sun" vanishes from its sealed display case during a brief power outage, and a shattered glass fragment is found on the Study floor.
case.escape_plan: Activate the hidden service elevator to the underground garage, slip into the waiting yacht concealed behind the pier, and sail away under the cover of night.

rooms.name: Terrace
rooms.description: An open-air terrace overlooking the sea, illuminated by elegant lanterns.

rooms.name: Main Hall
rooms.description: The grand hall where the exhibition is displayed, with high ceilings and polished marble.

rooms.name: Study
rooms.description: A quiet library‑like room adjacent to the main hall, housing the secure display case.

characters.name: Elena Marquez
characters.background: Curated a traveling exhibition, invited to the villa by the host to showcase rare works.
characters.secret: Stealing a priceless painting for a private collector
characters.goal: Secure the painting before it leaves the country
characters.alibi: Was in the Study reviewing the catalog at 9:00 PM

relationships.detail: Works with Victor on event security

lies: I was alone in the Study the whole time
The painting's case was never opened before tonight

characters.name: Victor Hale
characters.background: Hired to protect the villa's guests and its valuable artworks.
characters.secret: Was hired by a rival collector to sabotage the exhibition
characters.goal: Create chaos to devalue the painting

relationships.detail: Hired by Damien to secure the villa

lies: I never left the Garden during the blackout

characters.name: Sofia Liang
characters.background: Head chef for the evening, known for her daring culinary flair.
characters.secret: Owes a gambling debt to a mob boss
characters.goal: Find a way to pay off the debt without drawing attention
characters.alibi: In the Kitchen preparing desserts at 8:45 PM

relationships.detail: Met at a previous art gala

lies: I was in the kitchen the whole time
I didn't see anyone near the Study

characters.name: Damien Blackwood
characters.background: Owner of Villa Aurelia, host of the exclusive art gathering.
characters.secret: Master art thief known as "The Raven", using his philanthropist front to infiltrate high‑value collections
characters.goal: Steal the masterpiece and escape undetected
characters.alibi: Was on the Terrace giving a toast at 9:10 PM
lies: I was on the Terrace the whole time, nowhere near the Study
The painting was never my target

timeline.description: Guests arrive at Villa Aurelia, welcome speech by Damien.
Art exhibition opens in the Main Hall; the painting "Midnight Sun" is displayed.
Sofia leaves the kitchen to serve appetizers on the Terrace.
Elena claims she is in the Study reviewing the catalog.
Damien gives a celebratory toast on the Terrace.
Victor patrols the Garden and hears a glass shatter near the Study.
Security system experiences a 5‑minute blackout; logs show a manual overwrite.
The painting is discovered missing from its case.
Victor finds a broken glass fragment on the Study floor.
Sofia discovers a hidden service‑elevator access card tucked in a kitchen drawer.
Police arrive and begin their investigation.

evidence.name: Broken Glass Fragment
evidence.description: A small piece of tempered glass matching the display case, found on the Study floor.

evidence.name: Security Log Tampering
evidence.description: Digital log shows a 5‑minute gap at 9:18 PM, entry manually overwritten.

evidence.name: Chef's Apron with Mud
evidence.description: Apron with soil traces from the garden, found in kitchen trash.

evidence.name: Fingerprint on Vault Door
evidence.description: Partial fingerprint matching Victor's left thumb, smudged on the vault door.

evidence.name: Hidden Service Elevator Access Card
evidence.description: Card bearing Damien's name, grants access to hidden service elevator.

solution.target_true_identity: The hidden target posing as Damien Blackwood
solution.reasoning: The evidence contradicts their alibi and identity.

state.current_objective: Identify the hidden target among the suspects.
